# Positive fixture for FR-P3-CAPS-OWNED

Prose containing the same digits and words as several caps, in senses that have
nothing to do with a cap. It must **not** match, proving the patterns are anchored
and the gate never scans bare values — `1`, `2`, `required` and `understand` would
otherwise flag every ordinal, list index and ordinary sentence in the repository.

Step 2 of the build takes about 2 minutes. Section 1 of the adult guide is required
reading, and the child should understand what a rail is before moving on. There are
6 pages, and at most 3 of them carry a photograph.
